sentences.en: Well, Angela, Buick is bringing everyone a challenge to make the best of their Mondays.

sentences.zh: 我经常纠结的是，在应该工作的时候，我总想去干家务。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: So I actually like to do things on Sunday evening to set myself up for success on Monday.
sentences.zh: 所以我喜欢在周日晚上做些准备，好让周一能顺利开展工作。

sentences.en: So my Monday motivation starts on Sunday.

sentences.en: This makes me very happy.
sentences.zh: 这让我非常开心。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.zh: 我们会在周末完成所有的杂货采购和膳食规划。

sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢在周一早上拥有一个整洁的家庭办公室。

sentences.zh: 比如我甚至会在记事本上写下这一周的优先事项清单，

sentences.en: and I'll put it on my desk next to my computer on Sunday night.
sentences.zh: 然后在周日晚上把它放在电脑旁边的桌子上。

sentences.en: This is how I set myself up for a great Monday.

sentences.en: And I also know if one of those things doesn't happen, things can get walking.

sentences.zh: 我觉得我需要一个奋斗目标，你知道的，

sentences.en: like that light at the end of the tunnel kind of thing to keep me motivated.
sentences.zh: 就像隧道尽头的那道光一样，能让我保持动力。

sentences.en: And I have found with myself, if I think about like the big picture,
sentences.zh: 我发现对我自己而言，如果我总去想大局，

sentences.en: like everything I have to do that day or everything I have to do that week,
sentences.zh: 比如我当天或当周必须完成的所有事情，

sentences.zh: 我就会感到不知所措。

sentences.en: So I really just have to take it one day at a time.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的只能过一天算一天。

sentences.en: Oh, like what?
sentences.zh: 哦，比如什么样的奖励？

sentences.en: I mean, it doesn't have to be anything big.
sentences.zh: 我是说，不需要是什么大不了的事。

sentences.zh: 比如我辛苦工作了一整天，然后对自己说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Like this isn't like I'm...

sentences.en: Don't worry.

sentences.zh: 但那次散步就像是我的精神放松时刻。

sentences.en: I'm kind of the opposite of you, Angela.

sentences.zh: 我必须在清晨第一件事就去散步。

sentences.en: I find that I can quiet my brain if I work my body.
sentences.zh: 我发现只要活动身体，就能让大脑安静下来。

sentences.en: But what I do each morning to set myself up for a great day of work,
sentences.zh: 但我每天早上为了开启高效工作日所做的事情，

sentences.en: it also depends on what kind of work we're doing.
sentences.zh: 也取决于我们正在做什么样的工作。

sentences.zh: 比如，如果我们正在写书，

sentences.zh: 我有一套小小的例行程序，我称之为“精神热身”。

sentences.en: And I developed this from like...
sentences.zh: 这是我从……

sentences.zh: 听着，女士，我听过所有那些播客，

sentences.en: You love all that stuff.
sentences.zh: 你超爱那一套。

sentences.zh: 所以我总结出了这套方法。

sentences.en: I do 15 minutes of reading and then 15 minutes of journaling.
sentences.zh: 我先阅读15分钟，然后写15分钟日记。

sentences.en: I set a timer.
sentences.zh: 我会设定一个计时器。

sentences.en: But during that time, I keep a notepad next to me and I write down anything that jumps in my mind.
sentences.zh: 但在那段时间里，我会在旁边放个记事本，把脑子里蹦出来的任何想法都写下来。

sentences.en: Like it might be an idea for writing later, but it might be a chore or an email that I need to
sentences.zh: 可能是一个稍后写作的灵感，也可能是一件琐事，或者是一封我需要

sentences.en: return.
sentences.zh: 回复的邮件。

sentences.en: Right, right.

sentences.en: So that will really set me up for a great day of intense writing.

sentences.en: I like that.
